Chandra Asri Group is a leading chemical and infrastructure solutions company in Indonesia with a track record of over 34 years in the petrochemical industry. The company employs over 2,000 dedicated staff, incorporates state-of-the art technologies and supporting facilities located strategically in the country’s industrial hub, Cilegon and Serang. As a Growth Partner, Chandra Asri is committed on creating high-value jobs, expanding the domestic petrochemical value chain, and serving the needs of the vibrant and growing Indonesian market. Chandra Asri is currently expanding its portfolio in the energy sector and incorporating its asset as well as operational infrastructure to supports the expansion plan of the second world-scale integrated petrochemical complex in Indonesia, CAP2.

Responsibilities

• Build and maintain strong relationships with media and journalists, including developing and maintaining a relevant media network.
• Support crisis and issue management, including monitoring emerging issues, assessing communication implications, and preparing appropriate communication responses.
• Manage and support internal communication activities in a manufacturing/site environment and engage employees across different levels.
• Develop and coordinate communication materials, including press releases, media statements, talking points, speeches, Q&As, and internal communication content.
• Support corporate communication campaigns, events, media activities, and stakeholder engagement initiatives.
• Gather stakeholder insights and feedback to identify communication needs and improve communication effectiveness.
• Monitor media coverage, stakeholder sentiment, and emerging issues, and identify potential communication risks.
• Coordinate with internal stakeholders, particularly teams at the Cilegon site, to ensure clear, timely, and consistent messaging.
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation, media databases, reports, monitoring records, and other communication records.
• Support other corporate communication initiatives and projects as required.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in communications or a related field.
• Minimum 3-5 years of relevant experience, preferably working from manufacturing industry.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and negotiation skill
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with stakeholders.

Important Notes

Chandra Asri is only releasing official job posting at Chandra Asri Career Site (careers.chandra-asri.com), Linkedin & Jobstreet. The Company will contact shortlisted candidate via official corporate email & phone, and will not send any hardcopy invitation for interview. Please note that the Company doesn’t ask candidates to transfer some amount of money nor cooperate with any travel agent.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Perform warehouse tasks and operations.
- Handle maintenance and repair of warehouse equipment.
- Troubleshoot and resolve operational issues.
- Ensure compliance with warehouse standards and safety protocols.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date warehouse records.

- Melakukan tugas dan operasi gudang.
- Menangani pemeliharaan dan perbaikan peralatan gudang.
- Memecahkan dan menyelesaikan masalah operasional.
- Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap standar gudang dan protokol keselamatan.
- Memelihara catatan gudang yang akurat dan terkini.

Company:
KMI PT. Kalbe Morinaga Indonesia
